skills.name: mbse-systems-engineering
skills.description: Diagnose system behavior and weigh cross-discipline tradeoffs when a decision spans several parts of a system or its lifecycle.

skills.name: mbse-system-concept
skills.description: Compare system concepts and their feasibility when framing a problem or choosing how to meet stakeholder needs.

skills.name: mbse-conops
skills.description: Develop or review a ConOps covering who operates and supports a system, under what conditions, and with what authority.

skills.name: mbse-operational-scenarios
skills.description: Trace an operational scenario from trigger to outcome through actor actions, system responses, exceptions, and recovery.

skills.name: mbse-requirements
skills.description: Draft or review requirements from stakeholder needs, reconcile conflicting sources, and define acceptance conditions.

skills.name: mbse-architecture
skills.description: Allocate system functions, define interfaces, and compare architectures against required behavior and constraints.

skills.name: mbse-verification-evidence
skills.description: Plan verification, replay operator decision tables, or assess evidence for a requirement or intended use, including uncertainty and configuration applicability.

skills.name: mbse-baseline-review
skills.description: Review a baseline or change for conflicts across requirements, interfaces, risk controls, and supporting evidence.

skills.name: mbse-aerospace
skills.description: Assess aircraft or spacecraft design, mission behavior, safety, and assurance against the applicable program basis.

skills.name: mbse-defense
skills.description: Connect defense mission needs to architecture, acquisition, and sustainment decisions using organizational responsibilities and program evidence.

skills.name: mbse-automotive
skills.description: Assess vehicle behavior, E/E architecture, and driver interactions for functional safety, SOTIF, and cybersecurity.

skills.name: mbse-medical-device
skills.description: Assess medical device design and evidence against intended use, clinical workflow, patient and user risks, and regulatory context.

skills.name: mbse-electronic-systems
skills.description: Assess ASIC, FPGA, SoC, and control-electronics designs where physical limits, HW/SW interfaces, or verification affect system behavior.
